enchantments.tooltip: Heal +13: Passive: +13 Competence bonus to the Heal skill.
Repair +13: Passive: +13 Competence bonus to the Repair skill.
Devotion +60: Passive: +60 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Healing Lore V: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

Eternal Faith: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Eternal Faith increase the owner's effective level for the turning check by +2, his maximum Hit Dice turned by +2, and his total Hit Dice turned by +4.

Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver): This item could be upgraded if you found a Seal of the Stormreaver to combine it with. Bring this item to the Stormreaver Monument in Gianthold and combine it with a Seal of the Stormreaver to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.
